paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 3.37, with a decrease of 0.88% from the prior close and 29.45% over the last 23 sessions. There have been 6 new news articles in the last 24 hours. Recent news includes a price target reduction from Cantor Fitzgerald and a US regulator supporting a license for four AP1000 reactors at Fermi America's Project Matador.

A major shareholder, Toby Neugebauer, has sold shares of the stock in recent transactions, with sales reported on October 13th and 14th. Additionally, two entities tied to a 10% owner have also sold shares. The company has also detailed a $6.5 billion, 15-year TensorWave lease for 222 MW at Project Matador.

There have been recent SEC filings, including an 8-K form announcing a Limited Waiver and Amendment No. 1 to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd. and Form 4 and Form 144 filings related to insider transactions. The company has also posted a fact sheet on its website regarding its lease with TensorWave at the Project Matador site.
